2 . This is applicant's second bail application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

The applicant is being implicated in connection with Crime No.230/2022, registered at police station Badgonda, District Indore, for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(k) and 506 of IPC.
3. First bail application bearing M.Cr.C.No.49406/2022 was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 31.10.2022 with liberty to renew the prayer at an appropriate stage.
4. As per the prosecution, the prosecutrix was suffering from an ailment in her stomach and was not recovering.
She was told about the applicant who cures the diseases by performing certain rituals.

On 15.5.2022 the prosecutrix along with her husband, in-laws and Jeth Omprakash went to the Rahul Alias Pappu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73922387/

sentences.text: On 16.5.2022 at about 8.00 PM the prosecutrix and her husband went to the place of the applicant who asked her husband and Omprakash to sit in a circle and told them not to getup.
Thereafter he took the prosecutrix to another place near the river and got her to perform certain prayers.
He then took her to a field and made her stand and tied her eyes with a cloth.
Thereafter he pushed her to the ground and committed rape upon her and threatened her with knife.
On lodging of the report by the prosecutrix the applicant has been implicated and arrested for the present offence.
5 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The prosecutrix as well as her husband have been examined before the trial court and from their statements it is evident that it is a case of false implication.
Husband of the prosecutrix has admitted that prior to his marriage with the prosecutrix, she had ran away with some other person.
There are several omissions and contradictions in the court statement of the prosecutrix with her statements recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
Though rape is alleged to have been committed upon the prosecutrix in a field no external injury has been found upon her which renders the prosecution case doubtful.
Even in the medical report no internal injury has been found upon the prosecutrix who is a major lady.
It is further Signature Notsubmitted Verified that the applicant is in custody since 17.5.2022 and the trial is still Signed by: SHAILESH likely to take time for its conclusion.
Further custodial interrogation of the MAHADEV SUKHDEVE Signing time: 2/24/2023 11:54:57 AM applicant who is aged about 28 years is no longer required and he is the sole breadwinner for his family.
On such grounds, prayer for grant of bail to the applicant has been made.

6 . The aforesaid prayer has been opposed by learned counsel for the respondent/State submitting that in view of the allegations levelled against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail merely on the basis of statements of prosecution witnesses.
7 . I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case diary as well as statements of the witnesses.

8. The prosecutrix has been examined before the trial court and she has categorically affirmed the allegation against the applicant as made by her in the FIR and in her statements recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
She had promptly narrated the incident to her husband and had thereafter lodged the report on the very next day hence it cannot be said that there is any delay in lodging of the report.
The contradictions and variations in the statements of the prosecutrix and her husband as pointed out by the applicant are matter to be considered at the appropriate stage.
Mere absence of external injuries upon the prosecutrix is wholly insufficient to discredit her version at this stage.

Thus in view of the specific statement of the prosecutrix of the applicant having committed rape upon her which has been duly corroborated by the statement of her husband, I do not deem it to be a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.
The application being devoid of merits is hereby dismissed.
